Primary maps to tail_body and dorsal, secondary to tail_details, tertiary to tail_tips. The disconnected upper primary component is separated into a tintable dorsal fin. Converted to a white grayscale tint base; alpha preserved except that the south-facing dorsal is hidden behind the torso, matching existing Feroxi markings. Original 32x32 dimensions, four directions, four animation frames and 0.4-second frame delays preserved. No resizing or newly drawn pixels. Repacked from DMI frame-major order into RSI direction-major order. Asset license per source README.
